# Contributing to os-fleet

Thank you for considering contributing to os-fleet!

## How to contribute

Commit messages and branch names must follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)
specification.

1. Fork the repository
2. Create your branch: `git checkout -b fix/control-tower-timeout`
3. Commit your changes: `git commit -m 'fix(control-tower): add missing api timeout handling'`
4. Push to the branch: `git push origin fix/control-tower-timeout`
5. Open a Pull Request
